name: reactpod-platform
description: ReactPod community platform: REST API for apps, MCP server for AI clients (docs/platform/spec.md)

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:migrate
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/main.js --sourcemap --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:migrate: esbuild src/adapters/migrate.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist-migrate/migrate.js --sourcemap --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
